authority.destructive_boundary: Only rebuild the dsh-remote client bundle and restart the io.onlyservice.dsh-web launchd service; do not alter user settings, data, VPS, DNS, certificates, or unrelated plugins.

intent.goal: Make the DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 remote experience usable on portrait mobile viewports without regressing desktop behavior.
non_goals: Change private-link authentication, tunnel behavior, VPS configuration, or DNS
Change DSH_HOME, sessions, model settings, or persisted user data
General redesign of the DSH desktop interface

acceptance: MOB-01 session header, Chat and Trajectory views, long labels, and sidebar interaction fit 360x800, 390x844, and 412x915 without unintended page overflow or unreachable controls.
MOB-02 composer and Remote access controls remain readable and operable at mobile sizes and under visual viewport height changes, while desktop geometry remains unchanged.
final_evidence: Focused unit and CSS contract tests
Playwright geometry assertions and screenshots at 360x800, 390x844, 412x915 and desktop
Live local and public-domain smoke checks
Task and stage user-story alignment with drift score 0
outcome.first_evidence: A reproducible 390x844 existing-session viewport showing composer overlap and collapsed-details overflow on DSH 0.1.0-rc.6.

recovery.failure_strategy: Do not deploy a failing candidate; if the live smoke fails, restore the prior built plugin artifact or revert the compatibility changes and restart only io.onlyservice.dsh-web.
recovery.maintenance_window: Restart the local DSH web service only after focused tests and browser fixtures pass.
